text:
Sam_sales: Quick sync — NovaBank POC flagged three enterprise auth asks: SAML assertion transforms, SCIM group provisioning with delta sync, and RBAC scoping per domain. They also want strict domain-locking for tenant claims. Need to scope POC, timeline, and pricing. Anyone have quick wins?
Marie_se: Quick clarifying q's — are they OK with SAML 2.0 SP-initiated only or do they need IdP-initiated too? Which IdPs (Okta/Azure/OneLogin)? How many users/groups for the POC?
Alex_sales: They said Okta + Azure AD. Expect ~5k users org-wide but initial POC target is ~250 users and ~12 groups. Want full initial sync then delta thereafter.
Priya_security: Security checklist items: enforce signed assertions, audience and recipient validation, cert rotation procedure for IdP metadata, confirm SAML NameID format (transient vs persistent). For SCIM we prefer TLS + mTLS for Private; hosted will require TLS and our standard cert. Also need to confirm attribute hashing for any PII in logs.
Marie_se: For SCIM rate limits we default 60 req/min per org. For a 5k user full sync we recommend either bulk CSV import + SCIM delta, or a throttled SCIM run off-hours. We can do a bulk import during POC to avoid throttles.
Ian_product: Product tradeoffs: hosted is fastest to onboard but domain-locking & strict tenant isolation for regulated workloads push them to Dedicated or Private. Domain verification requires DNS TXT proof (control-plane callout) — for Private, customer runs verifier locally. That affects timeline and pricing.
Sam_sales: Pricing question — if they want SAML attribute transforms (custom mappings) and SCIM group filtering, is that an SE task included in POC or billed as eng work?
Marie_se: Minor attribute mapping (up to ~4h) is included in standard SE support. Anything requiring a custom transform or a new mapping engine path is engineering work (estimate 2–3 days). Group scoping/filtering can generally be handled by config flags — no engineering change expected.
Priya_security: Also note RBAC: we support role templates + resource tags. Need to confirm whether they require delegated admin per domain or cross-tenant admin roles. Please have them fill the SSO section of the security questionnaire; I'll attach the SAML checklist.
Sam_sales: Draft POC plan proposal: 1) Domain proofing + IdP metadata exchange, 2) Bulk user import + enable SCIM delta, 3) SAML assertion test matrix (signed/unsigned, audience, NameID variants), 4) RBAC template mapping + delegated admin test, 5) load/spike tests for token issuance and provisioning (target 100 rps for auth calls). Target timeline: 2 weeks. Thoughts?
Marie_se: Plan looks good. For spike tests we need a test Okta tenant or a SAML test IdP and a user dataset. Suggest bulk import run overnight. I can prepare a runbook + sample curl for bulk import.
Ian_product: For spike testing — recommend Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency. If they stay on hosted, we can enable a temporary burst window, but that may hit soft limits and results will be noisy. Dedicated trial pricing should be shared as an option.
Marie_se: I'll prepare a quote: POC SE support (8h), optional eng time quoted separately if a custom transform is needed, Dedicated trial pricing for 2 weeks.
Sam_sales: Priya — can you share the SAML checklist snippet we can send to customer? Marie — can you add the runbook + sample mapping example? I will update the customer and schedule kickoff for Tue.
Priya_security: Sharing SAML checklist excerpt here: - signed assertions required - enforce audience and recipient matching - certificate rollover/rotation plan - NameID format + persistence requirements - list of required SAML attributes and exact attribute names. I'll DM full security questionnaire. :white_check_mark:
Marie_se: runbook snippet:
```bash
# bulk SCIM import (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/novabank/import -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -F 'file=@users.csv'
```
Sample mapping notes: `user.email -> principal`, `user.firstName/lastName -> displayName`, `roles -> groups`. For SAML assertions example mapping we often do: `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User.externalId -> idp:employeeNumber`.
Sam_sales: :thumbsup: I'll send the calendar invite and kickoff agenda. Flag any legal/DSA blockers now — if they need a data processing addendum or extra audit logs we should surface that before kickoff.
Marie_se: Will add running notes and attach the quote draft once ready.
Priya_security: Noted — I'll confirm DPA/legal checklist items and attach a short security note we can hand to legal.
Sam_sales: Great — thanks all. If any enterprise blockers pop up (SAML vendor quirks, legal delays, domain ownership issues), ping here immediately and we'll triage.
